context: Two cafe friends compare gadgets and a weekend hike
purpose: Teach: アルミ/インターフェース/恵み/ファイナル/オオカミ/一時期/現物/人びと

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、その新しいタンブラー可愛いね。アルミ製？
lines.en: Mei, that new tumbler is cute. Is it aluminum?
lines.style: Aoi speaks with warm barista curiosity, gently observant tone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、アルミだよ。軽くて、操作のインターフェースもボタン一つだけなの。
lines.en: Yeah, aluminum. It's light, and the interface is just one button.
lines.style: Mei sounds dreamy yet enthusiastic, slightly drawn-out vowels softly

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へぇ、シンプルでいいね。週末の山登り用？自然の恵みを満喫って感じだ。
lines.en: Wow, nice and simple. Is it for weekend hiking? Sounds like enjoying nature's blessing.
lines.style: Aoi's tone is gentle, conversational, warmly envious and curious

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そう、今週末がシーズンのファイナル登山なんだ。一時期は毎週通ってたんだよ。
lines.en: Yes, this weekend is the season's final hike. There was a period I went every week.
lines.style: Mei reminisces softly, voice carrying nostalgic affection and warmth

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 毎週は凄い。山って、たまにオオカミが出るとか聞かない？ちょっと怖くて。
lines.en: Every week is amazing. Don't you hear about wolves in the mountains? A bit scary.
lines.style: Aoi laughs lightly, half-teasing, half-genuinely concerned voice

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 日本のオオカミはもういないから大丈夫。昔の人びとの話の中だけだよ。
lines.en: Japanese wolves don't exist anymore, so it's fine. They're only in old people's stories.
lines.style: Mei speaks thoughtfully, voice trailing into wistful reflection gently

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: なるほどね。そのタンブラー、今度写真じゃなくて現物見せてよ。
lines.en: I see. Next time show me the actual item, not just photos.
lines.style: Aoi sounds genuinely curious, playful and inviting tone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん、明日持ってくるね。アオイちゃんもきっと気に入るよ。
lines.en: Of course, I'll bring it tomorrow. Aoi, you'll definitely love it too.
lines.style: Mei sounds warm and softly promising, smile in her voice
